description: This file defines the MapType class in Apache Spark SQL module, representing the data type for map structures, including methods for serialization, string representation, nullability, and recursive transformations.

classes.name: MapType
classes.description: Represents the map data type in Spark SQL, including key and value types, nullability, and related methods.

methods.name: buildFormattedString
methods.description: Builds a formatted string representation of the MapType for debugging or display.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the MapType.

methods.name: defaultSize
methods.description: Estimates the default size of a MapType instance.

methods.name: simpleString
methods.description: Returns a simple string representation of the MapType.

methods.name: catalogString
methods.description: Returns the catalog string representation of the MapType.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representation of the MapType.

methods.name: asNullable
methods.description: Returns a nullable version of the MapType.

methods.name: toNullable
methods.description: Returns a nullable version of the MapType, same as asNullable.

methods.name: existsRecursively
methods.description: Checks recursively if a condition holds for this DataType and its children.

methods.name: transformRecursively
methods.description: Recursively transforms the DataType and its children using a partial function.
